verdict.rationale: Auth0's AI docs say agents can use CIBA to request user approval for sensitive operations via push, SMS, or email, even when the user is not active in the app. They also explicitly list 'human-in-the-loop controls with CIBA' as a feature. Separately, Strong Customer Authentication with Dynamic Linking ties transaction details to the approval, which matches the 'sensitive transaction' part of the story. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how the CIBA flow works (polling or notification handling, timeouts, how the approval binds to the agent's specific transaction), and independent or hands-on corroboration that agent CIBA works in practice.
